form.label: Endpoint Security & Hygiene
form.description: Wazuh integration, vulnerability management, and system health monitoring

search.query: index=linux sourcetype=wazuh:alerts | spath | eval severity=case( 'rule.level' >= 12, "Critical", 'rule.level' >= 7, "High", 'rule.level' >= 4, "Medium", 1=1, "Low" ) | timechart span=10m count by severity

index=linux sourcetype=wazuh:alerts | spath | search decoder.name="syscheck*" | eval file_path='syscheck.path' | eval change_type=case( match('syscheck.event', "added"), "File Added", match('syscheck.event', "modified"), "File Modified", match('syscheck.event', "deleted"), "File Deleted", 1=1, 'syscheck.event' ) | table _time, agent.name, file_path, change_type, syscheck.md5_after, syscheck.sha1_after, rule.description | sort -_time | rename agent.name as "Host", file_path as "File Path", change_type as "Change Type", syscheck.md5_after as "MD5", syscheck.sha1_after as "SHA1", rule.description as "Alert" | head 50

index=linux sourcetype=wazuh:alerts | spath | search decoder.name="vulnerability-detector" | eval severity=case( 'vulnerability.severity' == "Critical", "Critical", 'vulnerability.severity' == "High", "High", 'vulnerability.severity' == "Medium", "Medium", 1=1, 'vulnerability.severity' ) | stats count by agent.name, vulnerability.cve, severity, vulnerability.package.name | sort -severity, -count | rename agent.name as "Host", vulnerability.cve as "CVE", severity as "Severity", vulnerability.package.name as "Vulnerable Package", count as "Occurrences" | head 100

(index=linux sourcetype=yara | eval detection_source="YARA Scan", malware="YARA Match", affected_host=host) OR (index=linux sourcetype=linux_av:scan_summaries "hits" | eval detection_source="Linux Malware Detect", malware="LMD Detection", affected_host=host) OR (index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Defender" EventCode IN (1116,1117) | eval detection_source="Windows Defender", malware=ThreatName, affected_host=ComputerName) | table _time, detection_source, malware, affected_host | sort -_time | rename detection_source as "Detection Source", malware as "Malware/Threat", affected_host as "Affected Host" | head 50

(index=linux sourcetype=systemd unit=* (Failed OR failed)) OR (index=linux sourcetype=syslog "systemd" ("Failed" OR "failed to start")) OR (index=windows EventCode=7000 OR EventCode=7001) | eval service_name=coalesce(unit, Service_Name) | rex field=_raw "(?<service_name>[\w\-\.]+)\s+(failed|Failed to start)" | stats count by host, service_name | where isnotnull(service_name) | sort -count | rename host as "Host", service_name as "Failed Service", count as "Failure Count" | head 30

index=linux sourcetype=wazuh:alerts | spath | stats count by rule.id, rule.description, rule.level | sort -count | rename rule.id as "Rule ID", rule.description as "Description", rule.level as "Level", count as "Count" | head 30

index=linux sourcetype IN (linux_security_scan, linpeas, linux_rootkit) | rex field=_raw "(?i)(warning|alert|found|detected|vulnerable):\s*(?<finding>.+)$" | stats count by host, sourcetype, finding | sort -count | rename host as "Host", sourcetype as "Scanner", finding as "Finding", count as "Occurrences" | head 50
